lead102_u1_named_vs_blinded_read_correla.classification_evidence: 15 games, one family; the named-minus-blinded mean logit gap -0.009 has bootstrap interval -0.034 to +0.015 with probability positive 0.224, which is not a resolved wrong sign; no split-half reliability measured for the gap and no positive control proven.
lead102_u1_named_vs_blinded_read_correla.description: Correlation across 15 Week 9 games between the named LEAD-99 read (mean of 4 reads) and the name-blinded read (mean of 3 reads), logit scale, frozen prompt; bootstrap 95 percent interval.
lead102_u1_named_vs_blinded_read_correla.notes: Family lead102_name_blinded_control_read, 15 games, one family. Reads are stored under artifacts/lead99_llm_read/blinded/reads/. The stored analysis gives no probability_positive for the correlation, so none is recorded. Not recorded because a mean logit gap has no admissible effect unit: named-minus-blinded mean -0.009 logit [-0.034, +0.015], probability positive 0.224; SD of game gaps 0.050 against a noise standard error of 0.040; 2 of 15 games beyond two noise standard errors. Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the lane; no new measurement.
lead102_u1_named_vs_blinded_read_correla.plain_summary: Checks whether the written read of a game leans the same way once team and player names are hidden, to see how much of the read is reputation and how much is the facts.
